preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 3 and 70 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stones) == 3 and all(1 <= s <= n for s in stones)
preconditions.description: There are exactly three stones, each located on a distinct vertex numbered from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix is an n x n grid.

preconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))

preconditions.description: The main diagonal of the matrix contains '*' symbols.

preconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element of the matrix is a lowercase English letter or '*'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.split('\n')[0].isdigit() and all(len(move.split()) == 2 for move in stdout.split('\n')[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or consists of a number of moves followed by the moves themselves, each described by two integers.
The number of moves reported matches the number of move descriptions provided.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(move.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(move.split()[1]) <= n for move in stdout.split('\n')[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each move description contains two valid vertex numbers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (all(matrix[int(move.split()[0])-1][int(move.split()[1])-1] == matrix[int(move.split()[0])-1][int(move.split()[1])-1] for move in stdout.split('\n')[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each move is along a diagonal of the same color as the diagonal connecting the other two stones.
After all moves, the stones are located on vertices 1, 2, and 3.
The number of moves is minimal.
